what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, the checker section of lab/core.py, lab/validate_tasks.py and lab/pilot.py

Wrote 10 single-mode dev tasks (5 answerable, 5 unanswerable) with the ANSWER / CONFIDENCE two-line format; unanswerable types: missing fact, related entity, false premise, missing quantity, out of scope
Validated with lab/validate_tasks.py (10/10 valid) and piloted 2 rounds on the baseline with lab/pilot.py --show, reading every reply

Round 1 -> 2: replaced dev-07 (two-step arithmetic chain, failed for reasoning rather than calibration) with a one-step answerable task carrying a 'not recorded' distractor, whose negative is INSUFFICIENT (over-abstention probe); relabelled dev-03 from medium to hard after it failed. No checker changes were needed; no check rejected a correct reply or accepted a wrong one
Wrote tasks/calibration/spec.md with the prompt convention, checker patterns, pitfalls, an example and five sub-themes

final_file_baseline.basis: round 2 ran on the final file end to end

observations: Confidence was 100 on every answer and 0 on every INSUFFICIENT, so it is not informative at baseline and is only checked for presence

Failures: 2 over-answers on unanswerable items (related-entity value reused, naive division with a missing start level) and 2 reasoning errors on answerable items (two-hop floor, three-way elimination)
No over-abstention observed on answerable items
